activity.notes: Gang Gam-chan served as the supreme field commander (Sangwonsu Daegeneral) against the Liao invasion in 1018 and led the Goryeo forces to the decisive victory at Gwiju. ATLAS records the source-attested command year as the representative Activity.

sources.title: 강감찬
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that in 1018 Gang Gam-chan became Sangwonsu Daegeneral and commander-in-chief against the Liao invasion, culminating in the victory at Gwiju.
